capabilities: display a week-grid timetable with current week, today column and now line
assign courses to week ranges, odd/even weeks or specific weeks
track credits per course, week and semester
mark holidays, makeup days, cancellations and one-off events
export the current semester as iCal
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Data is stored in data.json so it syncs via Obsidian Sync, git or iCloud. UI is bilingual (Chinese/English).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a semester course timetable with week ranges, alternating weeks and per-day overrides.
summary: Timetable plugin that shows a week-based course schedule with odd/even week rules, multiple semesters, credits and iCal export.
